title: โรงเรียนพ่อแม่ 7 ครั้ง

editorial.author: Claude Code (AI draft) for PMH developer
editorial.medicalReviewer: ชื่อ นามสกุล (ตำแหน่ง)
reviewNotes: Narration derived only from lesson MCH68-INFO-002 v0.1.0; no new content.
Thai-speaking reviewer: check pronunciation of the gestational ranges ('หนึ่งถึงสิบสองสัปดาห์', 'สิบสามถึงยี่สิบเจ็ดสัปดาห์', 'ยี่สิบแปดสัปดาห์ขึ้นไป'), 'สิบแปดเดือน' and 'ใบประกาศนียบัตร'.

Stages use prefix 'ตอนที่' because the parts are places (คลินิกฝากครรภ์ / หลังคลอด + คลินิกเด็กสุขภาพดี / what to know each time), not time periods. Item numbers 1–7 match the session numbers; items 8–10 are narrated without 'ข้อ' numbers so they are not confused with sessions — check the on-screen badges 8–10 do not read as sessions 8–10.
Lesson has 4th session alone under หลังคลอด (PP ward); it is grouped with the Well Child Clinic sessions in stage 2 because a stage needs at least 2 items.
Lesson note: ranges are as printed on p4 ('1-12', '13-27', '28 สัปดาห์ขึ้นไป'); the stray 'Volume' overlay (HANDBOOK ISSUE) is ignored, as in the lesson.
Lesson note: 'staff write the date and sign for each session' (item 8, summary 2) is read from the table columns; the handbook does not say it in a sentence.
Lesson note: 'bring the handbook' (item 8, summary 2) comes from PDF p2, not p4.

Not used in the video: certificate e-mail line (PMH CLARIFICATION on how the e-mail field is used), SMART HYBRID / online sessions, the 9-volume คู่มือ and QR, and the editorial 'parenting-school day is a good time to ask'.
